newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia boosts Helsinki after Ericsson H1 report.
newsitem.headline: Nokia boosts Helsinki after Ericsson H1 report.

text.p: Shares rose in lively trade on Thursday with Nokia gaining on an above-forecast first-half earnings report from its Swedish rival Ericsson, and brokers said the positive tone would last.
"We'll end up by one to two percent for the day," one broker predicted when the FOX index was up about 1.4 percent.
Nokia jumped after Ericsson reported H1 pre-tax profits up 44 percent, and it sent the FOX and HEX indices up to new life-highs before retreating slightly.
Nokia traded up 18.00 markka at 443.00, but off an intraday high of 456.00, which was just short of its life-high 458.00.
Merita hit a new life-high 24.10 and then pulled back slightly to 23.90, still up 0.60 in hefty 60 million markka trade.
Brokers said overseas investors remained enthusiastic about the share following recent recommendations with high share price targets from various brokerages.
Some research reports have given 12-month price targets of 30 markka for Merita's stock. "Foreigners are looking at the gap," one broker said.
